title: Bram and the Glasshouse
author: Dominic Dravenmoor
blurb: Bram Coldharbour, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
